heuristics.scope: The Bonferroni factor is the constant 1 - 2^-8.5 = 0.99723786413599... per chaining value: E[J(J-1)]/2 <= 2^-8.5 E[J], and with E[J]=NA*ca_lo*q_pf*q3r=2^-65.24 the absolute loss is 2^-73.74. heuristics.statement: Group independence within a chaining value (the form of H5-group-independence of the accepted 44870635): good pairs of one chaining value that share no endpoint (a0 or u) are independent trials of the accepted event, each with probability q3r; good pairs sharing an endpoint form a group counted once. Consequence used: for a uniform chaining value and any table, J (accepted good pairs among all claws of the chaining value) has E[J(J-1)] <= 2^-7.5 E[J]. This filing applies the same premise to the kept-CV class ((cv0 >> 24) & 62 == 12): the class conditions only cv[0], the panel below is drawn from uniform chaining values (so about 1/32 of its CVs are in-class), and the transfer of the second-moment bound to the class-conditioned law is part of this declared premise.
